headline: Savar: Suspected bomb recovered from mosque field
summary: Police cordoned off the area after locals found a pressure cooker-like object wrapped in tape inside a plastic drum.
details: Police recovered a suspected bomb from the field of a mosque in Savar on Wednesday, August 12.
Local residents discovered a plastic drum containing clothes, a copy of the Quran, and an object resembling a pressure cooker wrapped in black tape.
The drum was found in the field of the Laltek Ghora Mosque in the Sadhapur Goperbari area of Savar on Tuesday night around 1:30 AM.
Following the report, police cordoned off the scene and deployed the Bomb Disposal Unit to neutralize and examine the object.
Authorities are currently investigating who placed the drum there and for what purpose it was left behind.
caption:
A pressure cooker-like object wrapped in black tape was found in a mosque field in Savar, sparking a bomb scare.

Police recovered a suspected bomb from the field of a mosque in Savar on Wednesday, August 12.

Local residents discovered a plastic drum containing clothes, a copy of the Quran, and an object resembling a pressure cooker wrapped in black tape.

The drum was found in the field of the Laltek Ghora Mosque in the Sadhapur Goperbari area of Savar on Tuesday night around 1:30 AM.

Following the report, police cordoned off the scene and deployed the Bomb Disposal Unit to neutralize and examine the object.

Authorities are currently investigating who placed the drum there and for what purpose it was left behind.

#Savar #BombScare #Bangladesh #Security #Police

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star

headline: Dhaka residents suffer as severe gas crisis returns
summary: Low pressure in households and empty CNG stations cause widespread disruption across the capital.
details: Gas supply has dropped significantly again, causing severe hardship for residents of Dhaka. On Wednesday, August 12, the crisis hit both domestic households and CNG filling stations across the city.
caption:
Cooking is impossible and CNG stations are empty. Dhaka is facing another severe gas crisis.

Gas supply has dropped significantly again, causing severe hardship for residents of Dhaka. On Wednesday, August 12, the crisis hit both domestic households and CNG filling stations across the city.
